title: SpecValley: Aggregation as Spectral Valley in Dense Heterophilic Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.14176v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Node classification in heterophilic graphs remains an open problem: aggregating over neighbourhoods can damp precisely the part of the signal that carries the labels. The field has answered with ever more expressive propagation operators, leaving the aggregation step that precedes them fixed by degree normalisation. However, degree normalisation acts as a spectral valley in its own right, attenuating a fixed middle band whose position at lambda equal 1 is set by the normalisation rather than by the data, exactly where the eigenvalues of dense graphs accumulate. We therefore begin with the representations rather than the propagation, in two stages: a learnable aggregation followed by an ordinary spectral filter. The first, SpecValley learns the position, sharpness and flank gains of the valley for every graph. We show formally how the aggregation operator and downstream filter interact. translated_title: SpecValley：将聚合作为稠密异质图中的谱谷
translated_abstract: 异质图中的节点分类仍然是一个悬而未决的问题：在邻域上进行聚合可能会恰好衰减信号中携带标签的那一部分。该领域以往的应对方式是设计表达能力越来越强的传播算子，却将其之前的聚合步骤固定为度归一化。然而，度归一化本身就像一个谱谷，会衰减一个固定的中频带，其位置（在 lambda 等于 1 处）由归一化方式而非数据决定，而这正是稠密图特征值聚集之处。因此，我们从表示而非传播入手，采用两个阶段的设计：先进行可学习的聚合，再进行普通的谱滤波。第一个阶段中，SpecValley 为每个图学习谱谷的位置、锐度和两侧增益。我们形式化地展示了聚合算子与下游滤波器之间的相互作用，并证明了响应 1 减 lambda 的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SpecValley方法，将图神经网络中固定为度归一化的聚合步骤改造为可学习的谱谷算子，为每个图自适应地学习衰减带的位置、锐度和两侧增益，从而解决稠密异质图中聚合会衰减携带标签信号的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SpecValley, which reformulates the degree-normalization aggregation step in graph neural networks as a learnable spectral valley operator that adaptively learns the position, sharpness, and flank gains of the attenuation band for each graph, addressing the damping of label-carrying signals in dense heterophilic graph node classification.
